graphite-ink.$description: Graphite Ink — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Default page canvas, card surfaces, button text on dark fills — the brightest neutral, used for main reading surfaces

linen-cream.$description: Linen Cream — Warm alternate section background, hero warm-tones, subtle washes — gives the page its boutique warmth and distinguishes sections from flat white

fog-veil.$description: Fog Veil — Quiet elevated surfaces, subtle hover washes, soft surface tints for inset regions

stone.$description: Stone — Hairline borders, input outlines, section dividers, nav-rule lines — the workhorse neutral for structural separation

pebble.$description: Pebble — Secondary/captive text, link body, helper copy — keeps muted text inside the warm-grey family instead of dipping into cool slate

onyx.$description: Onyx — Reserved for SVG icon fills and a few crisp borders where true black is needed for contrast on warm-cream surfaces

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Dark supporting neutral for text, icons, and strong contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

bronze-field.$description: Bronze Field — Hero/feature-block full-bleed background — a warm dark khaki that stages sculptural 3D illustrations without going full-black, maintaining the boutique-warm axis even in dark sections

tiempos.$description: Display and editorial heading serif — used at 56–84px for hero and section titles, 36px for sub-section heads, and 14–18px for emphasis lead-ins. Tiempos is the soul of the brand: a contemporary text serif with strong terminals that brings a Kinfolk-magazine / art-book quality to a fintech. The 500 weight is reserved for the largest display sizes where extra weight balances the tight tracking.

the-future.$description: Primary UI and body sans — a clean geometric workhorse used for paragraph copy, nav links, card titles, input fields, and small UI labels at 14–20px. The 500 weight appears in nav and a few mid-size emphasis lines. The near-zero letter-spacing (0.005em) keeps running text tight and un-fussy. It is the calm counterpart to Tiempos's editorial display.

wealthsimple-sans.$description: Tracked-out utility face for buttons, nav controls, and selected UI labels — used at 16px with 0.025em letter-spacing so that interactive elements read as distinct, almost stamp-like marks. The wide tracking pushes these elements forward visually without needing weight, reinforcing the pill-button rhythm across the system.
